Docs.param: a Java class object, must not be NULL.
the native methods in the class, must not be NULL.
Docs.summary: Registers native methods with the class specified by the clazz argument.

remarks.para: Registers native methods with the class specified by the clazz argument. The methods parameter specifies an array of JNINativeMethod structures that contain the names, signatures, and function pointers of the native methods. The name and signature fields of the JNINativeMethod structure are pointers to modified UTF-8 strings. The nMethods parameter specifies the number of native methods in the array.

Be aware that RegisterNatives can change the documented behavior of the JVM (including cryptographic algorithms, correctness, security, type safety), by changing the native code to be executed for a given native Java method. Therefore use applications that have native libraries utilizing the RegisterNatives function with caution.
